title: Smoked Pork Dumplings
description: Delicious smoked pork dumplings made with a hearty German-inspired filling, wrapped in flaky puff pastry, and steamed to perfection.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine the smoked pork fillet, chopped onion, chopped cabbage, ginger, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Roll out the puff pastry sheet to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Use a round cookie cutter to cut out circles of puff pastry.
Place 1 tablespoon of the smoked pork mixture onto the center of each puff pastry circle.
Fold the pastry in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges to seal.
Place the dumplings in the steamer, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Steam the dumplings for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Serve the smoked pork dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
